title: Event Details

fields.label: Event Type
fields.name: event_type
fields.instructions: Choose the type first. The form will show only the details that apply.

fields.label: Department
fields.name: event_department
fields.instructions: Select the department responsible for this event.

fields.label: Location
fields.name: event_location
fields.instructions: Choose a saved location. Add and manage locations from the Events menu.

fields.label: Short Description
fields.name: short_description
fields.instructions: A brief plain-language summary for calendar lists and popovers.

fields.label: Contact
fields.name: contact
fields.instructions: Enter the best public contact for questions about this event.

fields.label: Create a Landing Page
fields.name: has_landing_page
fields.instructions: Turn this on only when the event needs a full page with additional details.

fields.label: All-Day Event
fields.name: all_day
fields.instructions: Turn this on when no start or end time should be shown.

fields.label: End Date
fields.name: end_date
fields.instructions: Leave blank when the event ends on the start date.

fields.label: Repeating Event
fields.name: is_recurring
fields.instructions: Turn this on for a meeting or program that follows a repeating schedule.

fields.label: Recurrence Pattern
fields.name: recurrence_pattern
fields.instructions: Choose the simplest pattern that matches the real schedule.

fields.label: Interval
fields.name: recurrence_interval
fields.instructions: Use 1 for every week or month, 2 for every other week or month.

fields.label: Days of the Week
fields.name: recurrence_days
fields.instructions: Select every weekday on which this event occurs.

fields.label: Recurrence Start Date
fields.name: recurrence_start_date
fields.instructions: The first date covered by this repeating schedule.

fields.label: Recurrence End Date
fields.name: recurrence_end_date
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave blank for an ongoing series.

fields.label: Custom Dates
fields.name: custom_dates
fields.instructions: Add each occurrence date when the event does not follow a weekly or monthly pattern.

fields.label: Occurrence Exceptions
fields.name: occurrence_exceptions
fields.instructions: Add only the date that changes. The repeating schedule remains intact.

sub_fields.label: Public Note
sub_fields.name: note
sub_fields.instructions: For example: Cancelled due to weather.

fields.label: Warning Status
fields.name: warning_status
fields.instructions: Record whether the meeting has been legally warned.

fields.label: Virtual Meeting Link
fields.name: virtual_meeting_link
fields.instructions: Public link attendees should use to join the meeting.

fields.label: Agenda
fields.name: agenda
fields.instructions: Upload an agenda or provide an external link.

fields.label: Minutes
fields.name: minutes
fields.instructions: Upload approved minutes or provide an external link.

fields.label: Long Description
fields.name: long_description
fields.instructions: Full event details for the landing page.

fields.label: Gallery
fields.name: event_gallery
fields.instructions: Optional images for the event landing page. The featured image is managed in the standard Featured Image panel.

fields.label: Cost / Fee
fields.name: cost_or_fee
fields.instructions: Use plain language, such as “Free” or “$10 per person.”

fields.label: Related Event Series
fields.name: related_event_series
fields.instructions: Optional link to the recurring parent event.

description: Structured fields for meetings, programs, community events, closures, recurrence, exceptions, and optional event landing pages.
